name: brain
description: Ships the grill-me skill and the CONTEXT.md / ADR.md format specs. The two files live at the repo root, so any agent that greps the repo finds them; the hooks that enforce read-first and update-on-resolve are Claude Code only.

interface.shortDescription: CONTEXT.md and ADR.md, read first and kept current.
interface.longDescription: Keeps a project's durable context in two files at the repo root: CONTEXT.md for what things are, ADR.md for why the hard-to-reverse calls were made. Plain markdown that rides your normal pull request. No server, no account, no network.
defaultPrompt: Grill me on this plan, then record what lands.
What does CONTEXT.md say about this module?
